title: Harder: a Hindi FIR with an English bail order (scan errors), a date slip, and two different cheque cases between the same parties
note: Made-up documents. The FIR is in Hindi and its number appears in the order as 'Case Crime No.' (as in Uttar Pradesh). The order has typical scanning errors (0 for O). The two Mumbai complaints have the same parties but different complaint numbers and cheques, so they are two separate cases. Dates are written three ways.
